# Course Brochures Folder

Place your course brochure PDF files in this folder with the following names:

## Required Files:

- **beginner-english.pdf** - Beginner English course brochure
- **intermediate-english.pdf** - Intermediate English course brochure
- **advanced-english.pdf** - Advanced English course brochure
- **ielts-preparation.pdf** - IELTS Preparation course brochure
- **ielts-intensive.pdf** - IELTS Intensive course brochure
- **business-english.pdf** - Business English course brochure
- **conversation-club.pdf** - Conversation Club course brochure
- **academic-writing.pdf** - Academic Writing course brochure

## File Requirements:
- **Format**: PDF
- **Recommended Size**: Under 5MB per file
- **Content**: Should include course details, curriculum, pricing, schedule, and contact information

## How It Works:
When users click the "Download Brochure" button on the Courses page, the corresponding PDF will be downloaded automatically.

If a brochure file is missing, the download will fail. Make sure all brochure files are in place before deploying to production.
